subject: Join us for the Spring Concert — April 5, 2024
body_text: You're invited! Join us for our Spring Concert on Saturday, April 5, 2024 at 7:30 PM. Symphony Hall, Boston. Tickets available at the box office or online. Don't miss this special performance.

subject: Reminder: Team Trivia Night this Thursday February 8th
body_text: Don't forget! Team Trivia Night is happening this Thursday, February 8, 2024 at 7 PM at The Burren, Davis Square. Doors open at 6:30 PM. See you there!

subject: Your registration confirmed: Hackathon January 20-21 2024
body_text: Your registration for HackNEU 2024 is confirmed! The event takes place January 20-21, 2024 at Northeastern University. Check-in begins at 9 AM on Saturday. Please bring your student ID.

subject: Summer concert series — June 14 & July 4 2024
body_text: Join us this summer! Tanglewood Summer Concert Series. June 14, 2024: Boston Pops. July 4, 2024: Fireworks spectacular with the BSO. Tickets on sale now. Reserve your spot before they sell out.

subject: Re: Re: Re: Your interview is confirmed for Monday
body_text: Hi, just confirming your onsite interview scheduled for Monday August 28, 2025 at 10 AM at our Cambridge office. Please bring a photo ID. Our recruiter Sarah will meet you in the lobby. Looking forward to meeting you.

subject: You're invited: Startup Career Fair — February 22, 2025
body_text: Join us for the Spring Startup Career Fair on Saturday, February 22, 2025 from 12–4 PM in Curry Student Center Ballroom. Over 50 companies will be recruiting. Bring copies of your resume. Business casual attire recommended.

subject: Your Zoom webinar starts in 1 hour — December 10, 2024 at 2 PM ET
body_text: Reminder: You are registered for Introduction to Machine Learning, hosted by MIT OpenCourseWare. The webinar begins in 1 hour on December 10, 2024 at 2:00 PM ET. Click the link below to join.

subject: Spring Gala Fundraiser — May 10, 2025 at 7 PM
body_text: You are cordially invited to the Boston Children's Hospital Spring Gala on Saturday, May 10, 2025 at 7:00 PM at the Fairmont Copley Plaza. Black tie optional. Tickets are $250 per person. RSVP by April 30.

subject: Confirm your attendance: CS4100 Final Project Presentation December 12 2024
body_text: Hi students, please confirm your attendance for the CS4100 Final Project Presentations on December 12, 2024 from 2-5 PM in Ell Hall Room 312. Each group will have 10 minutes to present. All group members must be present.
